trigger_condition: No successful heartbeat for 15 minutes outside an approved maintenance window
maintenance_window_behavior: suppress while the approved maintenance window is active, then re-evaluate
customer_notification_condition: Notify after confirmation when service impact is likely or when the endpoint remains unreachable for 30 minutes
suppression_condition: Suppress duplicate alerts for the same endpoint while an incident is open
evidence_required: Alert payload, last successful check-in, maintenance-window check, reachability test, incident or ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close only after two consecutive successful heartbeats and incident notes are complete
notes: Example row; replace example.invalid with your controlled runbook location

trigger_condition: Two independent probes fail for 5 minutes
maintenance_window_behavior: record but do not page when a documented site-wide maintenance window explains the outage
customer_notification_condition: Notify when two probes confirm the outage or a redundant path also fails
suppression_condition: Suppress child-device offline alerts when the site gateway incident is confirmed
evidence_required: Probe results, last known topology, maintenance-window check, carrier status, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after both probes succeed for 10 minutes

trigger_condition: Free space below 10% or below the documented workload-specific floor for 15 minutes
maintenance_window_behavior: continue collecting evidence; route without paging unless the change creates immediate service risk
customer_notification_condition: Notify when remediation may interrupt service, capacity reaches the emergency floor, or risk remains after the response target
suppression_condition: Suppress only when an approved cleanup or expansion change is active
evidence_required: Disk trend, largest consumers, recent deployment or log growth, approved change or ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after free space remains above the recovery threshold for 30 minutes

trigger_condition: Available memory below the workload baseline and paging remains elevated for 20 minutes
maintenance_window_behavior: collect only during expected load tests that have an approved change record
customer_notification_condition: Notify when user-facing service degradation is confirmed or a restart/change is required
suppression_condition: Suppress only for an approved load test with an explicit end time
evidence_required: Memory trend, top consumers, paging metrics, related application health, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after memory and paging remain within baseline for 30 minutes

trigger_condition: CPU above 90% for 20 minutes and workload latency exceeds baseline
maintenance_window_behavior: collect evidence during approved batch jobs; do not page unless service health also fails
customer_notification_condition: Notify when confirmed saturation causes service degradation or requires an interruption
suppression_condition: Suppress only when the approved workload and time window match
evidence_required: CPU trend, top processes, service latency, scheduled task or change context, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after CPU and latency remain within baseline for 30 minutes

trigger_condition: Required service is stopped and one controlled restart attempt fails
maintenance_window_behavior: route to the change owner during an approved service restart; page if the service misses the planned recovery time
customer_notification_condition: Notify when the service supports a customer-facing workload or the recovery target is missed
suppression_condition: Suppress only when the exact service is part of an approved change window
evidence_required: Service state, dependent services, event records, restart result, change context, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after the service remains healthy through two checks and dependent health tests pass

trigger_condition: Latest scheduled backup failed or completed with unreadable data
maintenance_window_behavior: do not suppress unless an approved backup-platform change explicitly affects this job
customer_notification_condition: Notify when the recovery point objective is at risk or a restore test also fails
suppression_condition: Deduplicate repeated failure notifications for the same job while one ticket remains active
evidence_required: Job log, last successful backup, RPO calculation, storage status, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close only after a successful backup and evidence review; require restore validation when policy calls for it

trigger_condition: Scheduled restore test fails, produces integrity errors, or cannot start
maintenance_window_behavior: never suppress for routine maintenance without an approved risk acceptance and rescheduled test
customer_notification_condition: Notify immediately when the failed test threatens a documented recovery objective
suppression_condition: Suppress only an exact duplicate from the same test execution
evidence_required: Restore log, integrity result, source backup ID, target environment, ticket and risk record
auto_close_condition: Close after a successful retest and documented corrective action

trigger_condition: Security agent reports stopped, disabled, outdated, or disconnected for 15 minutes
maintenance_window_behavior: maintenance may explain a short restart; re-evaluate immediately after the window
customer_notification_condition: Notify when protection cannot be restored inside the target or a threat is also detected
suppression_condition: Suppress only for an approved agent upgrade with an explicit end time
evidence_required: Agent state, policy assignment, version, service health, recent changes, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after the agent reports healthy and current through two checks

trigger_condition: Security product reports a high-confidence malicious event or active containment
maintenance_window_behavior: never suppress because of a general maintenance window
customer_notification_condition: Follow the incident communication plan after validation and scope assessment
suppression_condition: Suppress only exact duplicate notifications tied to the same detection ID
evidence_required: Detection details, process tree, affected identity, containment state, timeline, incident ID
auto_close_condition: Close only through the incident-response procedure and documented recovery verification

trigger_condition: Unapproved account is added to a privileged group or an approved change lacks the expected ticket
maintenance_window_behavior: never suppress without an approved identity change record
customer_notification_condition: Notify according to the identity-incident plan when the change is unauthorized or cannot be explained
suppression_condition: Suppress only when the account, group, approver, ticket, and time window exactly match
evidence_required: Audit event, actor, target account, group, approval evidence, ticket or incident ID
auto_close_condition: Close after authorization is proven or access is removed and scope is reviewed

trigger_condition: Approved critical update fails twice or reaches the deployment-ring exception threshold
maintenance_window_behavior: route to the patch owner during the rollout; page only when exploitation risk or service impact requires it
customer_notification_condition: Notify when risk acceptance, service interruption, or customer action is required
suppression_condition: Deduplicate by update and endpoint while an exception record is active
evidence_required: Update ID, failure code, endpoint state, reboot state, retry evidence, exception or ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after successful installation or a time-bound approved exception is recorded

trigger_condition: Required reboot remains pending beyond the approved deadline
maintenance_window_behavior: continue measuring during maintenance; escalate when the window ends without a completed reboot
customer_notification_condition: Notify when user coordination or service interruption is needed
suppression_condition: Suppress only until the approved reboot deadline
evidence_required: Pending reason, deadline, user/session state, maintenance window, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after reboot and post-reboot health verification

trigger_condition: Agent service is stopped, repeatedly crashes, or cannot complete enrollment
maintenance_window_behavior: allow the documented agent-upgrade restart interval, then re-evaluate
customer_notification_condition: Notify when the endpoint cannot be managed inside the response target or alternate support is required
suppression_condition: Suppress only for an approved agent deployment or upgrade window
evidence_required: Agent version, service logs, enrollment identity, connectivity test, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after stable check-in, inventory reconciliation, and one successful authorized action

trigger_condition: Automation exits non-zero, produces an unexpected result, or exceeds the safety stop condition
maintenance_window_behavior: do not rerun automatically during change work unless the approved plan allows it
customer_notification_condition: Notify when failure changes endpoint state, affects many devices, or requires customer coordination
suppression_condition: Suppress only exact duplicate notifications for the same execution ID
evidence_required: Target set, version, approval, execution output, affected endpoints, rollback status, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after rollback or corrected rerun succeeds and affected endpoints are reconciled

trigger_condition: Remote-control session occurs without a matching ticket, approval, or permitted support window
maintenance_window_behavior: never suppress for a general maintenance window
customer_notification_condition: Notify through the incident plan when authorization cannot be proven
suppression_condition: Suppress only if the session ID and approval evidence are verified
evidence_required: Session actor, target, start/end time, ticket, approval, recording or audit reference, incident ID
auto_close_condition: Close after authorization review, scope assessment, and any required access remediation

trigger_condition: Certificate expires within 30 days and no approved renewal change exists
maintenance_window_behavior: continue routing during maintenance; do not page unless service risk becomes immediate
customer_notification_condition: Notify when customer validation, DNS, or service interruption is required
suppression_condition: Suppress only when a verified renewal change is scheduled before the risk threshold
evidence_required: Certificate subject, fingerprint, expiry, dependency map, renewal owner, change or ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after the new certificate is deployed and validated from each required path

trigger_condition: Disk reports predictive failure, RAID loses redundancy, or controller reports degraded state
maintenance_window_behavior: never suppress for routine maintenance without a hardware replacement change
customer_notification_condition: Notify when redundancy is lost, replacement requires downtime, or data risk increases
suppression_condition: Suppress only an exact duplicate while one hardware incident remains active
evidence_required: Controller state, affected disk, redundancy level, backup freshness, replacement plan, incident ID
auto_close_condition: Close after replacement, array rebuild, health verification, and backup review

trigger_condition: Loss or latency exceeds the documented path baseline for 10 minutes from two probes
maintenance_window_behavior: collect during approved network changes; page when the planned tolerance or recovery time is exceeded
customer_notification_condition: Notify when service degradation is confirmed or carrier action is required
suppression_condition: Suppress only when the affected path and time window match an approved change
evidence_required: Probe results, baseline, topology, interface health, carrier status, change or ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after both probes remain within baseline for 20 minutes

trigger_condition: Two resolvers cannot resolve a required internal or public service record for 3 minutes
maintenance_window_behavior: route to the change owner during approved DNS work; page if planned recovery is missed
customer_notification_condition: Notify when customer-facing services or authentication are affected
suppression_condition: Suppress only when the record and window exactly match an approved change
evidence_required: Resolver queries, authoritative response, TTL, recent change, dependency impact, incident ID
auto_close_condition: Close after internal and external resolution succeeds across two checks

trigger_condition: Documented critical event occurs more than the baseline count within 15 minutes
maintenance_window_behavior: collect during approved testing; route if the event exceeds the expected count or persists after the window
customer_notification_condition: Notify when the event correlates with service impact or requires a disruptive change
suppression_condition: Suppress only with an approved, time-bound exception for the exact event signature
evidence_required: Event sample, frequency, affected service, baseline, recent changes, ticket or exception ID
auto_close_condition: Close after the event returns to baseline and the root cause or accepted exception is documented

trigger_condition: New software outside the approved catalogue appears on a managed endpoint
maintenance_window_behavior: maintenance does not suppress inventory evidence; route according to the approved-change record
customer_notification_condition: Notify when removal, licensing, security review, or user coordination is required
suppression_condition: Suppress only when the package, version, endpoint scope, approver, and window match
evidence_required: Inventory delta, installer source, actor if known, approval or ticket, security assessment
auto_close_condition: Close after approval is confirmed or software is removed and inventory is reconciled

trigger_condition: Alert-to-ticket or webhook delivery fails twice or acknowledgement is missing for 5 minutes
maintenance_window_behavior: continue testing during an approved integration change; page if the recovery target is missed
customer_notification_condition: Notify when monitoring events are not reaching the accountable workflow
suppression_condition: Deduplicate retries for the same event ID while preserving delivery evidence
evidence_required: Payload ID, delivery attempts, response codes, target health, fallback route, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after delivery succeeds and the missing work items are reconciled

trigger_condition: Endpoint lacks one or more required monitoring policies after enrollment or policy change
maintenance_window_behavior: do not suppress; evaluate expected temporary gaps against the approved change record
customer_notification_condition: Notify when the gap creates material service or security risk
suppression_condition: Suppress only if the endpoint is explicitly exempted with an owner and expiry
evidence_required: Required-policy list, assigned-policy state, enrollment time, exception or ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after policy assignment and successful monitor execution are verified

signal: alert not linked to accountable workflow
trigger_condition: Test alert does not create or update the expected ticket, page, or queue item
maintenance_window_behavior: perform controlled tests in a documented window; do not suppress failed routing evidence
customer_notification_condition: Notify service leadership when the accountable workflow remains broken beyond the response target
suppression_condition: Suppress only exact duplicate test events
evidence_required: Test ID, alert payload, routing configuration, ticket or page result, remediation record
auto_close_condition: Close after a repeat test reaches the expected owner and acknowledgement is recorded

trigger_condition: Next review date is past due or the rule lacks an accountable owner
maintenance_window_behavior: do not suppress; schedule review work through normal governance cadence
customer_notification_condition: Notify only when overdue high-impact rules create a material control gap
suppression_condition: Suppress only after a new review date, owner, and ticket are recorded
evidence_required: Last review, next review, owner, change history, false-positive and missed-event evidence, ticket ID
auto_close_condition: Close after documented review and approval of retain, tune, disable, or replace

trigger_condition: More than the documented false-positive threshold within the review period
maintenance_window_behavior: do not suppress all events; use a reviewed temporary rule change when noise creates operator risk
customer_notification_condition: Notify when tuning changes customer-visible coverage or contractual monitoring
suppression_condition: Suppress only under a time-bound tuning change with rollback criteria
evidence_required: Alert count, false-positive count, missed-event review, threshold history, change and ticket IDs
auto_close_condition: Close after tuning, controlled testing, and post-change review meet the target
